blinds.mechanic_zh: 连续两拍分数差超过目标 40% 时,较低拍追加软目标。
blinds.mechanic_en: If two adjacent beat scores differ by more than 40% of target, the lower beat adds a soft target.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 抬升目标前有一道窄门,低分被门外留空。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, raised_target silhouette, threshold_gate modifier, front_gate orientation, locked_lower_void negative space, encoded count eight
blinds.mechanic_zh: 每拍必须达到目标的 80% 才能把任意分数计入段进度。
blinds.mechanic_en: A beat must reach 80% of target before any score contributes to section progress.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 三层抬升目标被可削去的红线压住。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, raised_target silhouette, triple_redline modifier, ascending_layers orientation, layered_shave_slots negative space, encoded count three
blinds.mechanic_zh: 本段总目标提高 30%;每次超额达标会削去一层提高值。
blinds.mechanic_en: Section target rises by 30%; each beat clear above target removes one layer of the increase.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 顺序环路回到两格前并被小闸标记。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, sequence_loop silhouette, two_step_marker modifier, clockwise_loop orientation, two_gap_lap negative space, encoded count two
blinds.mechanic_zh: 本拍重复两拍前的牌型时,本拍目标提高 20%。
blinds.mechanic_en: If this beat repeats the hand type from two beats ago, this beat target rises by 20%.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 顺序环路上两个相邻节点被同一盖片压住。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, sequence_loop silhouette, paired_rank_caps modifier, left_pair orientation, adjacent_node_voids negative space, encoded count two
blinds.mechanic_zh: 连续两拍以相同最高点数结算时,第二拍倍率减 25%。
blinds.mechanic_en: When two consecutive beats score with the same highest rank, the second beat loses 25% multiplier.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 顺序环路中的箭头被反向短钩拉回。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, sequence_loop silhouette, reverse_hook modifier, counter_clockwise_pull orientation, backtrack_channel negative space, encoded count one
blinds.mechanic_zh: 本段内牌型强度必须至少一次比上一拍更低,否则段目标提高。
blinds.mechanic_en: During this section, hand strength must drop below the previous beat at least once or the section target rises.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 四节点顺序环的第四节点被回声封片遮住。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, sequence_loop silhouette, fourth_node_plate modifier, bottom_right_node orientation, single_blocked_node negative space, encoded count four
blinds.mechanic_zh: 第 4 拍若复制本段任一既有牌型,该拍分数减半。
blinds.mechanic_en: On beat 4, copying any earlier section hand type halves that beat score.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 顺序环路首尾节点由断开的闭合夹连接。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, sequence_loop silhouette, open_end_clamp modifier, start_to_end orientation, broken_closure_gap negative space, encoded count two
blinds.mechanic_zh: 本段最后一拍必须不同于第一拍牌型,否则最后一拍归零。
blinds.mechanic_en: The section's final beat must differ from the first beat hand type or the final beat scores zero.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 顺序环路被五齿间距尺卡住。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, sequence_loop silhouette, five_tooth_spacing_rule modifier, top_arc orientation, wide_step_gap negative space, encoded count five
blinds.mechanic_zh: 每拍成牌点数总和不能与上一拍相差少于 5。
blinds.mechanic_en: Each beat's scoring-rank sum must differ from the previous beat by at least 5.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 顺序环路的下行箭头被斜闸切断。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, sequence_loop silhouette, downstep_slash_gate modifier, descending_right orientation, severed_arrow_gap negative space, encoded count one
blinds.mechanic_zh: 牌型强度低于上一拍时,本拍只计基础分。
blinds.mechanic_en: If hand type strength drops below the previous beat, this beat counts base chips only.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 顺序环路内嵌三段阶梯配额槽。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, sequence_loop silhouette, three_tier_quota modifier, triangular_cycle orientation, three_inner_slots negative space, encoded count three
blinds.mechanic_zh: 本段必须按低中高三档各完成一拍,缺一档则段目标提高。
blinds.mechanic_en: This section must include one low, one mid, and one high hand-strength beat or the section target rises.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 被抽干的金币环只剩一个空报价槽。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, drained_coin silhouette, single_offer_void modifier, center_empty orientation, one_square_hole negative space, encoded count one
blinds.mechanic_zh: 本段结束商店少出现 1 个报价槽。
blinds.mechanic_en: The shop after this section offers 1 fewer slot.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 抽干金币旁有八齿计数扣环。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, drained_coin silhouette, eight_tooth_meter modifier, right_attached orientation, meter_bite_gap negative space, encoded count eight
blinds.mechanic_zh: 本段若使用超过 8 次操作,段末利息减半。
blinds.mechanic_en: If this section uses more than 8 actions, end-section interest is halved.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 抽干金币左侧贴着双刻价签。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, drained_coin silhouette, double_price_tag modifier, left_tag orientation, tag_corner_cut negative space, encoded count two
blinds.mechanic_zh: 下个商店最左报价价格提高 2◆。
blinds.mechanic_en: The leftmost offer in the next shop costs 2 more coins.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 抽干金币被横向柜闸封住。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, drained_coin silhouette, till_bar modifier, horizontal_lock orientation, barred_coin_gap negative space, encoded count one
blinds.mechanic_zh: 本段结束商店不能刷新;购买仍正常。
blinds.mechanic_en: The shop after this section cannot reroll, but purchases still work.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 抽干金币下方漏出三格报价空洞。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, drained_coin silhouette, triple_offer_leak modifier, downward_drain orientation, three_drop_slots negative space, encoded count three
blinds.mechanic_zh: 每次低于本拍目标,下个商店随机一个报价变为空槽。
blinds.mechanic_en: Each beat below target turns one random next-shop offer into an empty slot.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 抽干金币上的折角券被空心斜闸压住。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, drained_coin silhouette, void_coupon_slash modifier, upper_right_slash orientation, folded_coupon_hole negative space, encoded count one
blinds.mechanic_zh: 下个商店折扣和免费来源失效一次。
blinds.mechanic_en: Discount and free-purchase effects fail once in the next shop.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 抽干金币上方悬着三枚被扣住的空币。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, drained_coin silhouette, three_held_coins modifier, overhead_hold orientation, triple_coin_void negative space, encoded count three
blinds.mechanic_zh: 进入本段时暂扣 3◆;清段后返还,失败则不返还。
blinds.mechanic_en: Entering this section holds 3 coins; clearing returns them, failing does not.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 抽干金币后方接着一个向右偏移的空店门。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, drained_coin silhouette, deferred_shop_gate modifier, right_offset orientation, shifted_door_void negative space, encoded count one
blinds.mechanic_zh: 本段后商店延后到下一段结束;奖励金币照常获得。
blinds.mechanic_en: The shop after this section is delayed until the next section ends; coin rewards still pay out.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 黑日圆盘吞掉外圈目标余量。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, black_sun silhouette, eclipse_bite modifier, centered_disc orientation, thin_outer_crescent negative space, encoded count one
blinds.mechanic_zh: 终幕每拍第一个达标分数正常计入;额外超分被吞没。
blinds.mechanic_en: In the finale, the first target clear each beat counts normally; extra over-score is swallowed.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 封闭舞台轮廓内有三枚固定槽封印。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, sealed_stage silhouette, triple_slot_seal modifier, front_locked orientation, three_fixed_windows negative space, encoded count three
blinds.mechanic_zh: 终幕开始后缓存位置封定;仍可交换牌,但槽位顺序不再改变。
blinds.mechanic_en: Once the finale starts, cache positions are sealed; swaps still work, but slot order no longer changes.

blinds.visual_metaphor: 静默仪表盘闭合,只留下单条窄读数窗。
blinds.prompt_subject: quiet dark-red composite blind symbol, silent_meter silhouette, single_readout_slit modifier, low_arc orientation, muted_needle_gap negative space, encoded count one
blinds.mechanic_zh: 终幕目标进度只在每拍结算后更新,拍内不显示实时进度。
blinds.mechanic_en: During the finale, target progress updates only after each beat scores, not live within the beat.
